positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I build software (Cisco Threat Response and SecureX) that helps security professionals research and respond to threats.  My work is in a combination of Clojure, Clojurescript, and Javascript, with some cool stuff like rules engines and state machines thrown in.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description: I manage the Product Development Team, which is a seven member subunit of the larger Engineering Department.  We are responsible for delivering the products and features that drive sales.  Our team runs the gamut from junior to principal engineers.  We're a remote-first culture, we primarily pair program, we follow an Agile development process, and we use Kanban to manage our work.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Clojure and Ruby on Rails developer doing a combination of product development and dev/ops work for a healthcare startup.  Built new products and features, set up continuous deployment, managed Cloudformation templates, configured Postgresql and Redis clusters, and put out fires with all of the above.  Acted as tech lead for the latter two years prior to transitioning to manager.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical Lead on various aspects of our company's implementation of Siebel CRM including: server infrastructure design, sizing and procurement for our dev, test and production environments, Siebel software installation and configuration on a Red Hat Linux operating system and the migration of customer data from multiple legacy systems into Siebel using EIM. Also spent time automating routine maintenance tasks such as EIM data updates and repository deployments with Python and its Fabric library.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: General developer and system administrator working on a team that supported customer-facing ISP systems.  My duties frequently involved Java, Python, and Perl development, Linux systems administration, vendor software integrations, resolving security issues and supporting internet technologies such as DNS, DHCP, customer Email, etc.  In short, I wrote, integrated and supported software that in turn supported the ISP business.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Helped develop an online account management system for a health savings bank.  The app included self-service interfaces for customers (account holders) and their employers and administrative interfaces for bank staff.  Written in C# with a Microsoft SQL Server database backend.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed software systems to manage classroom technology, to facilitate testing in mock clinical environments and to capture, catalog and deliver streaming video of lectures and other events.  Work was done mostly in C#, C, Perl and PHP with MySQL and Oracle Databases.

company.name: University of Wisconsin School of Medicine and Public Health

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Nov 1998

projects.title: DentistComparisons.com
projects.description: We built this site to make some passive income on the side.  It involved scraping insurance company website listings and government data sources, resolving addresses to coordinates, and doing distance calculations to find nearby dentists for site visitors.  Written in Python and Django with a Postgresql/PostGIS database.
